name: Graduation Vibe
steps: Open the classroom window twice to let the cherry blossoms come inside.
Open the grey locker, take the broom, and clean the trash on the floor.
Drag the boy to the girl so they hold hands.
Wipe the chalkboard to reveal the graduation message.
Tap the boy to fix his hand gesture.
Tap the girl to remove her face mask.
Drag the bush onto the principal’s head to give him leaf hair.
Drag the white towel to the hungry boy.
Tap the girl to change her skirt into shorts.
